subject: [hw] DONE V34 rev 2: foreign ion-share lifetime fix (IV); 2044/2044 + 103/103, real vpud reaches M-f
body:
DONE V34 rev 2. Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published. Rev 1 was accepted by R1 with no findings; rev 2 is the restart item root asked for (IV ion lifetime) plus its test.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v34/run_tests.sh
Last line:
  N2TEST V34 PASS 2044/2044
The same run prints:
  T34RESULT 2044/2044  (unit, ASan+UBSan -O1)   -> N2TEST V34 PASS 2044/2044
  T34RESULT 2044/2044  (unit, plain -O2)        -> N2TEST V34 PASS 2044/2044
  T34RESULT 2041/2041  (unit, TSan -O1; deliberate-fault case compiled out) -> N2TEST V34 PASS 2041/2041
  T34CORE 103/103      (V03 real loader + the phone s libvcodec_utility.so) -> N2TEST V34CORE PASS 103/103
  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v34/compile_ios.sh -> N2TEST V34-IOS PASS 2/2 (arm64-apple-ios16.5, compile only)
~68 s, -j2, nice 10, artifacts only under /tmp/n2hw-v34.

Rev 2 change (commit 5c45b81, STATUS 87113c1): an AP-published ion share is foreign. ion_import maps the share id to the AP dma handle; the importer s ion_free()and ion_share_close() are now successful no-ops that neither free the AP handle nor invalidate the share id, so the same fd imports again for the next encode. Local (guest ion_alloc) buffers keep the old free-once/close-the-share behaviour. Without this the real vpud imported 0x501 once, closed it after the job, and the second job failed with "[ERROR] ion_import failed, ion_buf_fd = 1281". Test added (+9 checks): register foreign share, import, close share, re-import (same handle), ion_free (returns 0, fake dma_free count unchanged), ION_MM_GET_IOVA still returns the AP pa, same share id imports again.

Integration evidence on the plain tree (no /tmp patches), host only:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh
    N2VHOST ion shares frame(fd=0x500)=0 bs(fd=0x501)=0
    N2VHOST encode seq-hdr bytes=0 key=0 / N2VHOST encode frame fds=1 bytes=0 key=0
    N2VHOST reached M-f: wait_irq(RWVC_IRQ_VENC, timeout_ms=1000) reached
  no ion_import/ringbuf error; the frame -110 is T02 fake hardware with no done script.

Everything from the rev 1 DONE still stands: all 35 names of D01 s android table + 2 data imports, 203-key property table extracted with `strings` and checked at test time, atrace/perf/sec_drv no-op returns, the ion custom-ioctl command numbers/offsets read off the vendor call sites, dl* restricted to the loaded n2elf set, log/exp2 in the soft-float ABI, __libc_init/__cxa_* handling, __stack_chk_guard + stderr data.

Not done / limits (full list in gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V34/STATUS.md 7):
- not run on the phone and not linked into a product build; iOS is compile-only.
- ion is still tested against a fake n2vc_hw and a stand-in DMA mirror; the M-f run above is the first real integration evidence, but the VENC itself does not encode (fake hardware).
- foreign share entries are never freed (the AP owns them), so 64 distinct shares per process is the hard cap; the runner publishes two.
- ion_alloc ignores heap_mask; alignment above the back end page size is logged once and not honoured; ion failures do not set guest errno; dladdr leaves dli_fbase 0 (no address->image query in the frozen loader API).
- open loader finding for V03: n2elf_describe() reports the previous symbol for the exact start of a Thumb function (V34 dladdr works around it).

Files changed this rev: gpu/hwcodec/shim/n2shim_android.c, gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v34/t_unit.c, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V34/STATUS.md. Nothing outside the package touched.

Staying available for R1/lead findings; R1: the delta since your accepted run is the ion lifetime rule and its test, everything else is unchanged.
